text:
(7) Nothing in this regulation shall have effect in relation to—
(a) the drugs specified in Schedules 4 and 5 or poppy-straw;
(b) any drug specified in Schedule 3 contained in or comprising a preparation which—
(i) is required for use as a buffering agent in chemical analysis;
(ii) has present in it both a substance specified in paragraph 1 or 2 of that Schedule and
a salt of that substance; and
(iii) is pre-mixed in a kit;
(c) any exempt product.
[F180(d) subject to paragraph (6) any drug which is required—
(i) for use in a prison; or
(ii) for use in a care home, which as its whole or main purpose provides palliative care
for persons resident there who are suffering from a progressive disease in its final
stages.]
[F181(8) In this regulation, “veterinary requisition” means a requisition which states, in accordance
with paragraph (2)(ii), that the recipient is a veterinary surgeon or veterinary practitioner.]
